8.title: Aṣṭama Bhava (8th House)
8.effect: Indrachapa / Kodanda sthita in the 8th Bhava grants deep, almost mystical intuition and a profound affinity for occult sciences and secret karmic mysteries. However, due to the shadowy, volatile nature of this Aprakasha Graha, there is an elevated risk of sudden, mysterious accidents, chronic hidden diseases, and unexpected upheavals. The native must exercise extreme caution regarding hidden enemies, covert conspiracies, and sudden transformations dictated by Maya.
